metamorphic_relations.name: Creature launched into sky
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a bear, mammoth, sabre cat, or other creature catapulted upward into the sky? The creature should be clearly flying unnaturally high, not just rearing up.

metamorphic_relations.name: Player or object floats upward
metamorphic_relations.check: Is the player character or an object (bucket, plate, basket) rising vertically into the sky?

metamorphic_relations.name: Creature animation anomaly
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a creature or NPC spinning in place, sliding across the floor without walking animation, twitching rapidly, or twisting their body in impossible ways?

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC or corpse clips through geometry
metamorphic_relations.check: Is an NPC or dead body partially embedded in a closed door, wall, or floor?

metamorphic_relations.name: Horse walks up vertical cliff
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a horse moving straight up a very steep or vertical cliff as if it were flat ground?

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC duplicates in same location
metamorphic_relations.check: Are two identical NPCs standing in the same place performing the same idle animation?

metamorphic_relations.name: Loose objects vibrate violently
metamorphic_relations.check: Are small objects (plates, books, bones) shaking, vibrating, or bouncing rapidly on a flat surface with no visible force applied?

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC stuck in T-pose or idle pose
metamorphic_relations.check: Is an NPC frozen in a rigid pose with arms stretched or body stiff while sliding or moving?

metamorphic_relations.name: Dragon skeleton stretches unnaturally
metamorphic_relations.check: After killing a dragon, does its skeleton twist, stretch, or snap into extreme elongated shapes across the terrain?
